goal: Extracellular inhibitory VHH design with Scientist-selected deeper outer-pore strategy.

task_release: Target chain L only; the PDB identifier, nanobody chain and native interface remain hidden from computational methods until scoring.
selection_rule: Deposited target-nanobody complex with unambiguous target chain, resolvable canonical mapping, experimentally observed interface and a target-only task that can be released identically to every computational method.
selection_rationale: Satisfies the predeclared rule with two protein entities, an unambiguous lysozyme target chain and VHH chain, and 1.5 A diffraction data; selected without inspecting any benchmark method output.
leakage_limit: Lysozyme/VHH structures may occur in model training. The method input hides the complex identity, and the native interface is used only for post hoc scoring; this remains a retrospective case, not a leakage-free prospective test.
